title: Qisqa xat va xabar yozish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida to‘g‘ri salomlashish va xayrlashuv, ohang, tinish belgilari va tuzilma bilan do‘stingizni taklif qiluvchi taxminan oltmish so‘zli xabar yoza olasiz hamda rahmat va uzr bildirasiz.

scenes.title: Qisqa xat va xabar yozish
scenes.say: Hello again! Today you will learn to write short messages, emails and invitations in English.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda restoranda menyu o‘qishni va hisob so‘rashni o‘rgandik. Bugun yozishga o‘tamiz: qisqa xat, elektron pochta va xabar. Salomlashish va xayrlashish shakllarini, norasmiy va yarim rasmiy ohangni, rahmat, taklif va uzr iboralarini hamda tinish belgilarini o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida do‘stingizga taklif xabarini yoza olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun inglizcha qisqa xabarlar, elektron xatlar va takliflar yozishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Xabarning tuzilishi
board: 2 Opening line: I hope you’re well.
scenes.say: A good message has a greeting, an opening line, a main message, a closing line and your name.
scenes.say_native: Har qanday qisqa xabar beshta qismdan iborat. Birinchi: salomlashish, masalan, “Hi Tom,”. Ikkinchi: kirish gap, “I hope you’re well”. Uchinchi: asosiy mazmun. To‘rtinchi: yakunlovchi gap, “Let me know”. Beshinchi: xayrlashuv so‘zi va ismingiz. Qisqa xabarda mazmun bitta-ikkita xatboshi bo‘ladi, ya’ni qirq-sakson so‘z. Tuzilma aniq bo‘lsa, o‘quvchiga tushunish oson.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi xabarda salomlashish, kirish gap, asosiy mazmun, yakunlovchi gap va ismingiz bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Norasmiy salomlashish
scenes.say: Hi Tom, Hello Anna, Hey Sam, Dear Anna,
scenes.say_native: Do‘stga yozganda “Hi Tom,” yoki “Hello Anna,” yetarli. “Hey Sam,” yana erkinroq, yaqin do‘stlar va tengdoshlar uchun. “Dear Anna,” esa xat va kartochkalarda ishlatiladi, u do‘stga ham, yarim rasmiy xatda ham mos. Inglizchada salomlashishdan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi: “Hi Tom,”. Undov belgisi ham bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin vergul ancha keng tarqalgan.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Tom. Salom, Anna. Hoy, Sem. Hurmatli Anna.

scenes.title: Yarim rasmiy salomlashish
board: Dear Ms Green, (ayol, oilaviy holati noma’lum)
scenes.say: Dear Mr Brown. Dear Ms Green. Dear Anna.
scenes.say_native: O‘qituvchiga, hamkasbga yoki yaxshi tanimagan odamga “Dear” va familiya bilan yozing. Erkak uchun “Mr Brown”, ayol uchun “Ms Green”. “Ms” ayolning turmush qurgan-qurmaganligini ko‘rsatmaydi, shuning uchun u eng xavfsiz. Britaniyada “Mr” va “Ms” dan keyin nuqta qo‘yilmaydi, Amerikada qo‘yiladi. Agar ism yaxshi tanish bo‘lsa, “Dear Anna,” ham bo‘laveradi.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob Braun. Hurmatli Grin xonim. Hurmatli Anna.

scenes.title: Kirish gaplar
board: How are you? / How are things?
scenes.say: Thanks for your message. I hope you're well. Sorry for the late reply.
scenes.say_native: Salomdan keyin bir qisqa kirish gap yozasiz. Eng foydali iboralar: “Thanks for your message” — xabaringiz uchun rahmat. “How are you?” yoki “How are things?” — do‘stga. “I hope you’re well” — umid qilamanki, yaxshisiz, bu hamma uchun mos. Kech javob berayotgan bo‘lsangiz, “Sorry for the late reply”. Shundan keyin darrov asosiy mavzuga o‘tasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xabaringiz uchun rahmat. Umid qilamanki, yaxshisiz. Kech javob berganim uchun uzr.

scenes.title: Salomlashishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Dear Mr Brown (vergulsiz, bir qatorda yozish)
scenes.say: Hi Tom, Dear Mr Brown, Dear Ms Green,
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. Birinchisi: “Hello dear friend Tom” kabi o‘zbekcha yoki ruscha uslubdagi uzun murojaat. Inglizchada qisqa: “Hi Tom,”. Ikkinchisi: do‘stga to‘liq ism-familiya bilan “Dear Tom Brown” yozish, bu juda rasmiy. Uchinchisi: murojaatdan keyin vergulni unutish. “Dear Mr Brown,” — keyin vergul va yangi qatordan boshlanadi.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Tom. Hurmatli janob Braun. Hurmatli Grin xonim.

scenes.title: Norasmiy xayrlashish
scenes.say: See you soon. Speak soon. Take care. Love, Anna.
scenes.say_native: Xabar oxiridagi xayrlashuv so‘zlari. Do‘stga: “See you soon” — tez ko‘rishguncha, “Speak soon” — tez orada gaplashamiz, “Take care” — o‘zingizni asrang. “Love” faqat yaqin odamlarga, oila a’zosiga. “Cheers” britaniyalik do‘stlar orasida “rahmat, ko‘rishguncha” ma’nosida uchraydi. “Best” — hamma uchun mos va qisqa. Keyin yangi qatordan ismingizni yozasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Tez ko‘rishamiz. Tez gaplashamiz. O‘zingizni asrang. Mehr bilan, Anna.

scenes.title: Yarim rasmiy xayrlashish
scenes.say: Kind regards. Best wishes. Best regards. Yours sincerely.
scenes.say_native: Yarim rasmiy xatda: “Kind regards” — hurmat bilan, “Best wishes” — eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, “Best regards” — eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan. Eng xavfsiz va ko‘p ishlatiladigani “Kind regards”. Britaniyada an’anaviy rasmiy xatda familiya bilan murojaat qilsangiz, “Yours sincerely” bilan tugatiladi, hozir shaxsiy xabarlarda esa kamroq. Hozircha “Kind regards” va “Best wishes” sizga yetarli.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmat bilan. Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan. Hurmat bilan. Chin ko‘ngildan hurmat bilan.

scenes.title: Xayrlashishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ I look forward to see you.
✓ Kind regards, / Looking forward to seeing you.
scenes.say: Kind regards. I look forward to seeing you. Looking forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “Hurmat bilan” ni so‘zma-so‘z “With respect” deb tarjima qilish. Inglizcha xatda bu g‘alati yoki nizoli eshitiladi. To‘g‘risi “Kind regards”. Ikkinchisi: “look forward to see”. Bu yerda “to” predlog, shuning uchun fe’l -ing shaklida: “I look forward to seeing you”. “Looking forward to hearing from you” — javobingizni kutaman, degani.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmat bilan. Sizni ko‘rishni intizorlik bilan kutaman. Javobingizni kutaman.

scenes.title: Murojaat va xayrlashuvni tanlang
board: 3) a manager, Ms Green, you don’t know well
scenes.say: Your best friend Sam. Your teacher, Mr Brown. A manager, Ms Green.
scenes.say_native: Uch kishiga xabar yozmoqchisiz. Birinchi: eng yaqin do‘stingiz Sem. Ikkinchi: o‘qituvchingiz janob Braun. Uchinchi: yaxshi tanimagan menejeringiz Ms Green. Har biriga mos salomlashish va xayrlashuvni ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Eng yaqin do‘stingiz Sem. O‘qituvchingiz janob Braun. Menejeringiz Grin xonim.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Hey Sam, ... See you soon, / Love
scenes.say: Hi Sam, See you soon. Dear Mr Brown, Kind regards. Dear Ms Green, Kind regards.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Do‘st uchun: “Hi Sam,” yoki “Hey Sam,” va oxirida “See you soon” yoki “Take care”. O‘qituvchi uchun: “Dear Mr Brown,” va “Kind regards,”. Menejer uchun: “Dear Ms Green,” va “Kind regards,”. Ko‘rdingizmi, rasmiy murojaatlar va xayrlashuv juftlikda ishlaydi: ikkalasi ham bir xil rasmiylik darajasida bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Sem, tez ko‘rishamiz. Hurmatli janob Braun, hurmat bilan. Hurmatli Grin xonim, hurmat bilan.

scenes.title: Norasmiy va yarim rasmiy ohang
board: Informal: I’m, can’t, Thanks, Can you...?
Semi-formal: I am, cannot, Thank you, Could you...?

examples.t: Can you send me the file?
Could you send me the file, please?

scenes.say: Can you send me the file? Could you send me the file, please?
scenes.say_native: Ohangni ikki darajaga bo‘lamiz. Norasmiy: qisqartmalar — “I’m”, “can’t”, “Thanks”, savol — “Can you”, undov belgisi va hatto emoji. Yarim rasmiy: to‘liq gaplar, “Thank you”, “Could you … please?”, undov belgisi kam, emoji yo‘q. Yarim rasmiy ohang o‘qituvchi, hamkasb va yangi tanishlar uchun. Qisqartmalar juda kam qo‘llansa ham xato emas, lekin hamma joyda ham yaxshi eshitilmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Faylni yubora olasizmi? Iltimos, faylni yuborishingiz mumkinmi?

scenes.title: Sms tili rasmiy xatda
board: ✗ Hi Mr Brown, can u send it asap? thx
✓ Dear Mr Brown, could you send it as soon as possible? Thank you.
u, pls, thx, gonna — faqat do‘stlarga
scenes.say: Dear Mr Brown, could you send it as soon as possible? Thank you.
scenes.say_native: Do‘stlarga yozgan qisqartmalar: “u” — you, “pls” — please, “thx” — thanks, “gonna” — going to. Ular do‘stlar orasida normal. Lekin o‘qituvchi yoki menejerga “can u send it asap? thx” deb yozsangiz, hurmatsizlik bo‘ladi. Yarim rasmiy xatda to‘liq so‘zlar yozing: “Could you send it as soon as possible? Thank you.”
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob Braun, iloji boricha tezroq yubora olasizmi? Rahmat.

scenes.title: Yarim rasmiyga o‘giring
scenes.say: Thanks for the email. Can you call me back? I can't come. Sorry!
scenes.say_native: Uchta norasmiy gapni yarim rasmiy ohangga o‘tkazing. Birinchisi: “Thanks for the email”. Ikkinchisi: “Can you call me back?”. Uchinchisi: “I can’t come. Sorry!”. Eslang: “Thank you”, “Could you … please”, “I am afraid I cannot” va “I apologise” kabi shakllar mos keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Xat uchun rahmat. Menga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qila olasizmi? Kela olmayman. Uzr!

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) Could you call me back, please?
3) I am afraid I cannot come. I apologise.
scenes.say: Thank you for your email. Could you call me back, please? Unfortunately, I cannot come. I apologise.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Thank you for your email.” Ikkinchi: “Could you call me back, please?” Uchinchi: “I am afraid I cannot come. I apologise.” Siz “Unfortunately, I cannot come” ham deyishingiz mumkin. “Unfortunately” — afsuski, bu yarim rasmiy xatlarda rad etishni yumshatadi. Eslab qoling, “apologise” britaniyacha yozilishi, amerikaliklar “apologize” yozadi.
scenes.say_uz: Xatingiz uchun rahmat. Menga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qila olasizmi? Afsuski, kela olmayman. Uzr so‘rayman.

scenes.title: Rahmat aytish
board: Thank you for + noun: Thank you for your help.
Thanks for + -ing: Thanks for inviting me.

examples.t: Thank you for the lovely gift.

scenes.say: Thank you for your help. Thanks for inviting me. Many thanks. I really appreciate it.
scenes.say_native: Rahmat bildirishning formulasi: “Thank you for” va undan keyin ot yoki fe’lning -ing shakli. “Thank you for your help”, “Thanks for helping me”. Kuchliroq: “Thanks a lot”, “Many thanks”. Yana “I really appreciate it” — buning uchun juda minnatdorman. Rahmat xabarida uch narsa bo‘lsin: nima uchun rahmat, bu sizga qanday yordam bergani va kelajakka yaxshi tilak.
scenes.say_uz: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. Meni taklif qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Katta rahmat. Bunga juda minnatdorman.

scenes.title: Thank you for xatolari
board: ✗ Thanks for invite. / Thanks for to invite me.
✓ Thanks for the invitation. / Thanks for inviting me.
scenes.say: Thank you for your help. Thanks for the invitation. Thanks for inviting me.
scenes.say_native: Rahmat xabarlarida uchta xato. “Thank you for help” — kerakli so‘z, “your” yoki “the”, tushib qolgan. “Thanks for invite” — “invite” fe’l, ot emas, ot shakli “invitation”. “Thanks for to invite” — “for” dan keyin “to” qo‘yilmaydi, fe’l -ing shaklida. To‘g‘risi: “Thanks for inviting me”.
scenes.say_uz: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. Taklif uchun rahmat. Meni taklif qilganingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Rahmat xabarlari
board: 3) a nice dinner at a friend’s house
scenes.say: A birthday gift. Help with homework. A nice dinner at a friend's house.
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyatda rahmat aytish gapini tuzing. Birinchi: tug‘ilgan kunda sovg‘a oldingiz. Ikkinchi: kimdir uy vazifangizda yordam berdi. Uchinchi: do‘stingiz sizni mazali kechki ovqatga mehmon qildi. Har biriga “Thank you for” yoki “Thanks for” ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Tug‘ilgan kun sovg‘asi. Uy vazifasida yordam. Do‘st uyida mazali kechki ovqat.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Thank you for the lovely gift.
2) Thanks for helping me with my homework.
3) Thank you for the delicious dinner.
scenes.say: Thank you for the lovely gift. Thanks for helping me. Thank you for the delicious dinner.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar: “Thank you for the lovely gift”, “Thanks for helping me with my homework”, “Thank you for the delicious dinner”. Uchinchisini davom ettirib, “It was a great evening” deb yozish yaxshi, chunki rahmat iliqroq bo‘ladi. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lsa-yu, “for” dan keyin ot yoki -ing kelsa, to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say_uz: Ajoyib sovg‘a uchun rahmat. Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. Mazali kechki ovqat uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Taklif qilish
board: Would you like to come to...?
I’d like to invite you to...

examples.t: Would you like to come to my party?
I'd like to invite you to dinner.

scenes.say: Would you like to come to my party? It's on Saturday at 7 p.m. Please let me know by Friday.
scenes.say_native: Taklif xabarida to‘rtta ma’lumot kerak: nima, qachon, qayerda va qanday javob berish. Iboralar: “Would you like to come to my party?” yoki “I’d like to invite you to dinner”. Ikkinchisi yarim rasmiyroq. Oxirida “Please let me know by Friday” va “I hope you can come” yozing. Sana va vaqtni aniq ko‘rsating: “on Saturday at 7 p.m.”.
scenes.say_uz: Mening ziyofatimga kelishni xohlaysizmi? U shanba kuni soat 7 da. Iltimos, juma kunigacha xabar bering.

scenes.title: Taklifga javob
board: Yes: I’d love to come! Thanks for inviting me.
No: Sorry, I can’t make it.
No: I’m afraid I can’t. I have to...
Sorry, I’m busy. Maybe next time!
scenes.say: I'd love to come! Thanks for inviting me. Sorry, I can't make it. Maybe next time!
scenes.say_native: Taklifga javob ham sizning yozish mahoratingiz. Rozilik: “I’d love to come!” va “Thanks for inviting me”. Rad etish: “Sorry, I can’t make it” — kechirasiz, kela olmayman. Sababni qisqa ayting: “I have to work”. Yumshatish uchun: “Maybe next time!” — keyingi safar balki. Rad etishni “Sorry” yoki “Unfortunately” bilan boshlash odobli.
scenes.say_uz: Albatta kelaman! Meni taklif qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Kechirasiz, kela olmayman. Balki keyingi safar!

scenes.title: Tinglang: ofisda xat
board: Ben: I need to write to Ms Green about the meeting.
Ben: Semi-formal. I don’t know her well.
Kate: Start with Dear Ms Green. End with Kind regards.
Ben: And I should say thank you for her time.
scenes.say: I need to write to Ms Green about the meeting. Is it formal? Semi-formal. I don't know her well. Start with Dear Ms Green. End with Kind regards. And I should say thank you for her time. Yes. Don't write thx!
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ofisda Ben yig‘ilish haqida menejer Ms Green ga yozmoqchi. Hamkasbi Keyt unga qanday salomlashish va xayrlashishni maslahat beradi. Eshiting: Keyt nimani tavsiya qiladi va nimani yozmaslikni aytadi?
scenes.say_uz: Ms Green ga yig‘ilish haqida yozishim kerak. U rasmiymi? Yarim rasmiy. Men uni yaxshi tanimayman. Dear Ms Green bilan boshlang. Kind regards bilan tugating. Va vaqti uchun rahmat aytishim kerak. Ha. Thx deb yozmang!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) How should he start and end?
scenes.say: Who does Ben write to? How should he start and end? What should he not write?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Ben kimga yozadi? Ikkinchi: Keyt xatni qanday boshlash va qanday tugatishni maslahat beradi? Uchinchi: nimani yozmaslik kerak? Qisqa va aniq javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Ben kimga yozadi? Qanday boshlab, qanday tugatadi? Nimani yozmasligi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: To Ms Green. Dear Ms Green and Kind regards. He should not write thx.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Ms Green ga, ya’ni menejerga. Ikkinchi: “Dear Ms Green,” bilan boshlab, “Kind regards,” bilan tugatadi. Uchinchi: “thx” kabi sms tilini yozmaydi. Keyt yana bir yaxshi maslahat berdi: “thank you for her time”, ya’ni vaqti uchun rahmat. Shu bilan xat odobli chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: Ms Green ga. Dear Ms Green va Kind regards. U thx yozmasligi kerak.

scenes.title: Uzr so‘rash

examples.t: I'm sorry I missed your call.

scenes.say: Sorry for the late reply. I'm sorry I missed your call. I apologise for the delay.
scenes.say_native: Uzr so‘rashning uch qismi bor: uzr, sabab va yechim. Uzr: “Sorry for the late reply” yoki “I’m sorry I missed your call”. “Sorry for” dan keyin ot yoki -ing; “I’m sorry” dan keyin to‘liq gap. Sabab: “I was at work”. Yechim: “I will call you tonight”. Yarim rasmiy xatda “I apologise for the delay” deyiladi. Ortiqcha uzr so‘ramang, bitta samimiy uzr yetarli.
scenes.say_uz: Kech javob berganim uchun uzr. Qo‘ng‘iroqingizni o‘tkazib yuborganim uchun uzr. Kechikish uchun uzr so‘rayman.

scenes.title: Uzr so‘rashdagi xatolar
board: ✓ I’m sorry I’m late. / Sorry for being late.
scenes.say: I'm sorry I'm late. Sorry for being late. I'm sorry I forgot.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. “Sorry for late” — “late” sifat, “for” dan keyin esa ot yoki -ing shakli kerak: “Sorry for being late” yoki “I’m sorry I’m late”. Ikkinchisi: “Sorry for I forgot” — “for” dan keyin to‘liq gap kelmaydi. To‘g‘risi “I’m sorry I forgot” yoki “Sorry for forgetting”. “For” bilan gap emas, ot yoki -ing qo‘llanadi.
scenes.say_uz: Kechikkanim uchun uzr. Kechikkanim uchun uzr. Unutganim uchun uzr.

scenes.title: Uzr so‘rang
board: 1) You answered an email after a week.
3) You cannot come to a meeting.
scenes.say: You answered after a week. You forgot a birthday. You cannot come to a meeting.
scenes.say_native: Uch vaziyatda uzr so‘rang. Birinchi: elektron xatga bir haftadan keyin javob berayapsiz. Ikkinchi: do‘stingizning tug‘ilgan kunini unutdingiz. Uchinchi: yig‘ilishga kela olmaysiz. Har biriga uzr, qisqa sabab yoki yechim qo‘shing.
scenes.say_uz: Bir haftadan keyin javob berdingiz. Tug‘ilgan kunni unutdingiz. Yig‘ilishga kela olmaysiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Sorry for the late reply. I was very busy.
2) I’m so sorry I forgot your birthday! Let’s celebrate this weekend.
3) I apologise, but I cannot come to the meeting.
scenes.say: Sorry for the late reply. I'm so sorry I forgot your birthday. I apologise, but I cannot come.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “Sorry for the late reply. I was very busy.” Ikkinchi: “I’m so sorry I forgot your birthday! Let’s celebrate this weekend.” Bu yerda uzr, so‘ng yechim bor. Uchinchi: “I apologise, but I cannot come to the meeting.” Oxirgisiga “Unfortunately I have another appointment” ham qo‘shish mumkin.
scenes.say_uz: Kech javob berganim uchun uzr. Tug‘ilgan kuningizni unutganim uchun juda uzr. Uzr, lekin kela olmayman.

scenes.title: Hammasini birlashtirish
board: I hope you’re well! ... Would you like to come? ...
Please let me know by Thursday.
scenes.say: Hi Maya, I hope you're well! I'm having a small birthday party on Saturday at 7 p.m. Would you like to come? Please let me know by Thursday. See you soon, Dilnoza.
scenes.say_native: Endi bularni birlashtiramiz. Namuna taklif xabari: “Hi Maya, I hope you’re well! I’m having a small birthday party at my flat on Saturday at 7 p.m.” Keyin: “Would you like to come? Please let me know by Thursday. See you soon, Dilnoza”. Salomlashish, kirish, taklif, ma’lumot, javob muddati va xayrlashuv — hammasi joyida. Bu taxminan ellik so‘z.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Maya! Umid qilamanki, yaxshisiz! Shanba kuni soat 7 da kichik tug‘ilgan kun ziyofati qilaman. Kelishni xohlaysizmi? Iltimos, payshanbagacha xabar bering. Tez ko‘rishguncha, Dilnoza.

scenes.title: Katta harf va nuqta
board: Capital letter: I, Anna, Monday, May, English, Uzbek
scenes.say: Capital letters: I, Anna, Monday, May, English. Use one exclamation mark, not three.
scenes.say_native: Tinish belgilari. Katta harf bilan yoziladi: gap boshi, “I” olmoshi, ismlar, hafta kunlari, oylar, millat va til nomlari — “Monday”, “May”, “English”, “Uzbek”. Bu o‘zbekchadan farq qiladi, bizda hafta kuni va til nomi kichik harf bilan yoziladi. Gap oxirida nuqta, savol belgisi yoki undov belgisi. Undov belgisini bittadan ortiq qo‘ymang: “Thanks!!!” sayoz eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Katta harflar: I, Anna, Monday, May, English. Uchta emas, bitta undov belgisi qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Vergul va apostrof
scenes.say: Hi Tom, First, we have food, music and games. I'm happy. This is Anna's book.
scenes.say_native: Vergul qaerda kerak? Salomlashishdan keyin: “Hi Tom,”. “First,” “However,” kabi kirish so‘zlardan keyin. Ro‘yxatda: “food, music and games”, oxirgi “and” oldidan odatda vergul qo‘yilmaydi. Apostrof esa qisqartmada: “I’m”, “can’t” va egalikda: “Anna’s book”. Ko‘plik uchun apostrof qo‘yilmaydi: “two friends”, “two friend’s” emas.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Tom. Avval, bizda taom, musiqa va o‘yinlar bor. Men xursandman. Bu Annaning kitobi.

scenes.title: Tinish belgilari xatolari
board: ✓ Hi Tom, I am happy. / See you on Monday!
scenes.say: Hi Tom, I am happy. See you on Monday! Two friends.
scenes.say_native: Uch xato. Birinchisi: kichik harf bilan “hi tom” yoki “i am”. “I” doim katta harf. Ikkinchisi: hafta kuni va oyni kichik harf bilan yozish, undov belgilarini ko‘paytirish. “See you on Monday!” — bitta undov. Uchinchisi: ko‘plikda apostrof qo‘yish: “two friend’s” noto‘g‘ri, “two friends”. Apostrof faqat qisqartma va egalikda.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Tom, men xursandman. Dushanba kuni ko‘rishamiz! Ikki do‘st.

scenes.title: Xabarni to‘g‘rilang
board: hi anna thanks for your email i cant come on friday im sorry see you on monday
scenes.say: hi anna thanks for your email i cant come on friday im sorry see you on monday
scenes.say_native: Mana tinish belgilarsiz xabar: “hi anna thanks for your email i cant come on friday im sorry see you on monday”. Uni to‘g‘ri yozing: katta harflar, vergul, nuqta va apostrofni qo‘ying. Qanday bo‘lishini ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Salom Anna, xatingiz uchun rahmat, juma kuni kela olmayman, uzr, dushanba kuni ko‘rishamiz.

scenes.title: To‘g‘rilangan xabar
board: Thanks for your email. I can’t come on Friday. I’m sorry.
scenes.say: Hi Anna, thanks for your email. I can't come on Friday. I'm sorry. See you on Monday!
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri variant: “Hi Anna,” — yangi qatorda. Keyin: “Thanks for your email. I can’t come on Friday. I’m sorry.” Va yana yangi qatorda: “See you on Monday!” Hamma narsa o‘z o‘rnida: katta harflar “Hi”, “Anna”, “I”, “Friday”, “Monday”, apostroflar “can’t” va “I’m”, nuqtalar va bitta undov belgisi.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Anna, xatingiz uchun rahmat. Juma kuni kela olmayman. Uzr. Dushanba kuni ko‘rishamiz!

scenes.title: Xat ko‘rinishi
board: Matn: qisqa xatboshilar, ular orasida bo‘sh qator
scenes.say: Subject: Party on Saturday. Hi Maya. New line, new paragraph, then Kind regards.
scenes.say_native: Xat ko‘rinishi ham muhim. Elektron xatda qisqa mavzu yozing: “Subject: Party on Saturday”. Salomlashish alohida qatorda. Matn qisqa xatboshilarga bo‘linadi, xatboshilar orasida bo‘sh qator. Xayrlashuv va ism ham alohida qatorda. Sanani Britaniyada “14 June” yoki “14th June” deb yozadi, Amerikada esa “June 14”. Qisqa matn xabarda ko‘rinish sodda: bitta qisqa xatboshi.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: shanba ziyofati. Salom, Maya. Yangi qator, yangi xatboshi, keyin Kind regards.

scenes.title: Elektron manzilni diktant qilish
board: anna.smith@mail.com → anna dot smith at mail dot com
scenes.say: Anna dot Smith at mail dot com. Full stop, comma, question mark.
scenes.say_native: Xabar yozishda manzillarni og‘zaki aytish ham kerak. “@” belgisi — “at”. Nuqta — “dot”. Chiziqcha — “hyphen” yoki “dash”. Pastki chiziq — “underscore”. Masalan, “anna.smith@mail.com” aytilishi: “anna dot smith at mail dot com”. Tinish belgilari uchun: nuqta — “full stop” (Britaniya) yoki “period” (Amerika), vergul — “comma”, savol belgisi — “question mark”.
scenes.say_uz: Anna nuqta Smit at mail nuqta com. Nuqta, vergul, savol belgisi.

scenes.title: Manzilni ayting
scenes.say: anna.smith@mail.com. dil-karimova@post.co.uk.
scenes.say_native: Ikki manzilni ovoz chiqarib ayting: “anna.smith@mail.com” va “dil-karimova@post.co.uk”. Har belgini inglizcha ayting: at, dot, hyphen. “Co.uk” ni “co dot uk” deb aytasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita elektron manzilni ayting.

scenes.title: Manzillar qanday aytiladi
board: anna dot smith at mail dot com
dil hyphen karimova at post dot co dot uk
scenes.say: Anna dot smith at mail dot com. Dil hyphen karimova at post dot co dot uk.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri aytilishi: birinchi manzil — “anna dot smith at mail dot com”. Ikkinchi — “dil hyphen karimova at post dot co dot uk”. Hech narsa unutilmasa, juda yaxshi. Telefonda yoki yuzma-yuz manzil aytganda, sekin gapiring va muhim joylarda to‘xtang. Harflar tushunarsiz bo‘lsa, harflab aytish ham kerak: yodingizda bo‘lsin, alifbo darsi sizga yordam beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Anna nuqta Smit at mail nuqta com. Dil chiziqcha Karimova at post nuqta co nuqta uk.

scenes.title: Tinglang: ovozli xabar
board: I’m having a barbecue in my garden on Sunday at 3 p.m.
Would you like to come? Bring your sister if you like!
Hope to see you there. Bye!
scenes.say: Hi Lucy, it's Mark. I'm having a barbecue in my garden on Sunday at 3 p.m. Would you like to come? Bring your sister if you like! Please text me by Friday. Hope to see you there. Bye!
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — ovozli xabar. Mark do‘sti Lyusiga taklif qoldiradi. Eshiting: taklif nimaga, qachon va javobni qachongacha berish kerak? Bu xabarni yozma xabarga aylantirish mumkin. Mana shu ma’lumotlar yozma taklifning asosi.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Lyusi, bu Mark. Yakshanba kuni soat 3 da bog‘imda barbekyu qilaman. Kelishni xohlaysizmi? Xohlasangiz, opangizni ham olib keling! Iltimos, juma kunigacha menga xabar yozing. Sizni u yerda ko‘rishga umid qilaman. Xayr!

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
scenes.say: What is the invitation to? When is it? Who can Lucy bring? When must she reply?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: taklif nimaga? Ikkinchi: qachon? Uchinchi: Lyusi kimni olib kelishi mumkin? To‘rtinchi: qachongacha javob berishi kerak? Aniq ma’lumot bilan javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Taklif nimaga? Qachon? Lyusi kimni olib kelishi mumkin? Qachongacha javob berishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: A barbecue. On Sunday at 3 p.m. Her sister. By Friday.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Markning bog‘idagi barbekyuga. Ikkinchi: yakshanba kuni soat uchda. Uchinchi: opasini. To‘rtinchi: juma kunigacha. E’tibor bering, taklifning hamma kerakli ma’lumoti bor edi: nima, qachon, qayerda va qachongacha javob berish. Yozma taklifingizda ham shu to‘rtta narsa bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Barbekyu. Yakshanba soat 3 da. Uning opasi. Jumagacha.

scenes.title: Taklif yozing
scenes.say: Plan a message to invite a friend. Think about what, when, where and the reply date.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Do‘stingizni biror narsaga taklif qiling: ziyofat, kechki ovqat yoki kino. Og‘zaki rejalashtiring: salomlashish, kirish gap, nima, qachon, qayerda, qachongacha javob berish va xayrlashuv. Uyda uni yozasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘stingizni taklif qilish uchun xabar rejalashtiring. Nima, qachon, qayerda va javob muddatini o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy taklif
board: I hope you’re well! I’m having a small birthday party at my flat on Saturday at 7 p.m. My address is 12 Green Road, near the park. We will have food, music and games.
Would you like to come? Please let me know by Thursday. I really hope you can join us!
scenes.say: Hi Maya, I hope you're well! I'm having a small birthday party at my flat on Saturday at 7 p.m. Would you like to come? Please let me know by Thursday. See you soon, Dilnoza.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna, taxminan oltmish so‘z. Salomlashish, kirish, nima, qachon va qayerda, so‘ng taklif va javob muddati, oxirida xayrlashuv. Gaplarning ko‘pi qisqa, vergul, nuqta va undov belgisi o‘z joyida. Siz ham uy vazifangizda shu tuzilmaga amal qilsangiz, yaxshi natija chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Maya! Umid qilamanki, yaxshisiz! Shanba kuni soat 7 da kvartiramda kichik tug‘ilgan kun ziyofati qilaman. Kelishni xohlaysizmi? Iltimos, payshanbagacha xabar bering. Tez ko‘rishguncha, Dilnoza.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: Parts: greeting, opening, message, closing, name
Thank you for... / Sorry for... / Would you like to...?
scenes.say: Choose the right tone. Be clear and polite. Check capitals and punctuation.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Xabarning tuzilishi: salomlashish, kirish, mazmun, yakun, ism. Norasmiy: “Hi Tom”, “See you soon”. Yarim rasmiy: “Dear Ms Green”, “Kind regards”. Rahmat: “Thank you for” va ot yoki -ing. Taklif: “Would you like to come”. Uzr: “Sorry for” va “I’m sorry I”. Katta harf, vergul, nuqta va bitta undov belgisi. Eng muhimi, murojaat va ohang bir xil darajada bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri ohangni tanlang. Aniq va xushmuomala bo‘ling. Katta harf va tinish belgilarini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say: Your homework: write a message of about sixty words to invite a friend. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: do‘stingizni taklif qilib, taxminan oltmish so‘zli xabar yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: salomlashish va xayrlashuv bor, nima-qachon-qayerda aniq, javob muddati ko‘rsatilgan, katta harflar va tinish belgilari to‘g‘ri. Yozib bo‘lgach ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi darsda sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: do‘stingizni taklif qilib, taxminan oltmish so‘zli xabar yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Do‘stingizni taklif qilib, taxminan oltmish so‘zli xabar yozing: salomlashish va xayrlashuv, nima-qachon-qayerda, javob muddati bo‘lsin; katta harflar va tinish belgilarini tekshiring.
